response.original_title: 『!!Cruise-Reservation-Support!!』How do I include another room in my existing Norwegian cruise booking?
response.overview: To add a room, cabin, guest or passenger on my Norwegian Cruise, call Customer Service directly at 【+1-888-512-8367 (US)】or 【+44-120 420-8151 (UK)】 or reach out to your travel advisor. Because each cabin requires its own booking, an agent will set up a new, 【+1-888-512-8367 (US)】separate reservation. Make sure to ask them to officially link your booking numbers so your group shares the same main dining table and scheduled activities. To add a room to your Norwegian Cruise booking, contact 【+1-888-512-8367 (US)】 or 【+44-120 420-8151 (UK)】Norwegian Cruise or your travel advisor as soon as possible. You can also check “Manage My Booking” on. Additional staterooms depend on availability 【+1-888-512-8367 (US)】 or 【+44-120 420-8151 (UK)】and pricing, and linking reservations helps keep your group together for dining and activities. Fare differences may apply when adding cabins. Early requests improve chances of adjacent rooms.
